decisions.reason: The encrypted secondary channel is a low-cost add-on to the firm's core security platform, and since it was only ever mentioned rather than featured, little evidence has resolved its value, so the option is worth keeping open for now.
Moving to a dedicated page in 2019 signals further commitment to the end-to-end security architecture, which underpins the firm's offering and costs little to maintain.
The QR-code hardware token was promoted to its own page and fits regulatory demand for strong customer authentication, so its prospects still justify holding the option.

The payment compliance suite received no extra promotion, which leaves its value uncertain, but ongoing PCI and PSD2 requirements keep it potentially valuable at modest maintenance cost, so dropping it is not yet justified.
